claim: A single exhaustively proven exact value r_3(m) yields an explicit ceiling r_3(n) <= ceil(n/m)*r_3(m) for every n, hence an explicit numeric bound on limsup r_3(n)/n.

facets.mechanism: interval covering with ceil(n/m) blocks of length m
facets.method: derive a global density ceiling from one exact extremal value
facets.outcome: explicit unconditional numeric upper bound on the 3-AP-free density
facets.entities: 3-AP-free subsets of the first n integers
